title: just-deliver catalog runtime
description: The compute every workload gets. Never required by name: it has no contract and no classes. Expressions (${...}) are kept as raw strings by the loader and evaluated later. Unique by name across shared resources, components and runtimes.

name.description: Same pattern as a component name.

description.description: What the runtime gives a team.

uses.description: The shared resources its nodes may read as ${<name>.<export>} (checked by the resolver).

implementations.description: Environment type (declared in the Catalog file) or 'default' -> implementation. An environment uses its type's implementation, else 'default'.

nodes.description: Graph nodes by name; the node named 'runtime' is the workload's runtime, deployed by the release flow (phase runtime).

probe.description: How to check the deployed runtime is healthy. The graph carries it on the runtime node.

x-jd.message: required: this jd reads it from the runtime; a catalog written for an older jd lacks it, so add it (see catalog/runtimes/container-app.yaml).

timeoutSeconds.description: How long to keep trying before the revision counts as unhealthy (grants may take minutes to propagate).

intervalSeconds.description: Wait between attempts; at most timeoutSeconds.

scheme.description: The URI scheme the probe asks the revision's address with: <scheme>://<fqdn><path>.

release.description: Which inputs and outputs of the runtime node's template the release flow (dark revision, grants, probe, traffic shift) uses. The engine sets the two inputs, so the runtime node must not.

x-jd.message: required: this jd reads it from the runtime; a catalog written for an older jd lacks it, so add it (see catalog/runtimes/container-app.yaml).

suffixInput.description: Template input that receives the revision suffix.

trafficInput.description: Template input that receives the traffic list.

trafficOutput.description: Output echoing the traffic last deployed; names the live revision.

suffixOutput.description: Output echoing the revision suffix last deployed; the next run compares it with its own.

revisionOutput.description: Output naming the revision a deploy created.

fqdnOutput.description: Output with that revision's address, the probe target.

revisionKey.description: Key of a traffic item that names a revision.

latestKey.description: Key of a traffic item that means the latest revision.

weightKey.description: Key of a traffic item's weight.

resourceIdOutput.description: Output with the runtime resource's id; qualification looks up its live revisions by it.

suffix.description: How the release flow names a revision: the prefix, then hex digits of the config's hash and of a salt. Its parts must fit maxLength (checked at load).

configDigits.description: Hex digits of the config's SHA-256 (64 at most).

saltDigits.description: Hex digits of the salt's SHA-256 (64 at most).

maxLength.description: The longest suffix the runtime accepts.

fullWeight.description: The traffic weight that sends all traffic to one revision.
